_note: Excerpt showing the schema. The full question bank is kept out of this public repo so students can't read the answer key.

categories.name: Hardware Hunt
categories.blurb: The physical parts inside the machine

questions.prompt: Which part is often called the "brain" of the computer?
questions.explanation: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) reads and carries out the instructions that make every program run.

questions.prompt: What is the main circuit board that connects all of a computer's parts together?
questions.explanation: The CPU, RAM, storage, and expansion cards all plug into the motherboard so they can talk to each other.

primary.prompt: An IPv4 address is made of 4 bytes. How many BITS is an IPv4 address in total?
primary.explanation: 4 bytes × 8 bits per byte = 32 bits. Unit 1 math, Unit 2 addresses.

backups.prompt: A photo, a song, and an encrypted HTTPS web page are all sent across the internet in packets. Underneath it all, every packet is made of what?
backups.explanation: No matter what the data is, the computer represents it in binary.

backups.prompt: What does each letter stand for in CPU and in DNS?
backups.answer: CPU = Central Processing Unit. DNS = Domain Name System.
accept: Central Processing Unit AND Domain Name System (both required)
backups.explanation: One acronym from each unit. Both must be correct.

spares.prompt: What is the small, oval, reversible connector used to charge most new phones and laptops?
spares.explanation: USB-C carries power, data, and even video through one cable.
